directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: I have a case for you about one person.
entries.JA_current: I have a case for you about one person.
entries.JA_new: ある人物について頼みがある。
そうか、どんな厄介事だ？

entries.EN: The situation is as follows: some people are looking for a stalker named Strelok, along with me. I don't know who these people are, but I really want to find out. I know for a fact that they have a man of theirs here in the bar, known only as "The Agent". I do not know his real name, maybe you can tell me?
entries.JA_current: The situation is as follows: some people are looking for a stalker named Strelok, along with me. I don't know who these people are, but I really want to find out. I know for a fact that they have a man of theirs here in the bar, known only as "The Agent". I do not know his real name, maybe you can tell me?
entries.JA_new: こういう状況だ。ストレロクというストーカーを、俺と一緒に探している連中がいる。誰なのか分からないが、正体を知りたい。確かなのは、そいつらの仲間がバーにいることだ。「エージェント」としか呼ばれてない。名前も知らない。あんたなら誰か分かるか？

entries.EN: Yeah, that's what it means... To the catcher, as they say... Heh-heh! I wasn't talking to you. As for your question, yes, I think I know who you're talking about. I can tell you, but not for nothing, because nowadays information is of great value. So, if you want to know who this agent is, you can do a job for me.
entries.JA_current: Yeah, that's what it means... To the catcher, as they say... Heh-heh! I wasn't talking to you. As for your question, yes, I think I know who you're talking about. I can tell you, but not for nothing, because nowadays information is of great value. So, if you want to know who this agent is, you can do a job for me.
entries.JA_new: そういうことか……獲物が網にかかった、ってやつだな。へへっ、あんたに言ったんじゃない。質問の答えだが、誰のことか分かると思う。教えてやってもいいが、ただじゃない。今じゃ情報は高く売れるからな。エージェントの正体を知りたいなら、俺の仕事を引き受けろ。

entries.EN: Kill a stalker. Neutral. Wanna know why? I'll explain: he witnessed some events that he should not have seen.
entries.JA_current: Kill a stalker. Neutral. Wanna know why? I'll explain: he witnessed some events that he should not have seen.
entries.JA_new: ストーカーを一人始末しろ。ローナーの奴だ。理由を知りたいか？ 説明してやる。そいつは、見てはいけない出来事を目撃した。

entries.EN: Don't worry, you can put your moral principles aside. Just to put your sensitive conscience at ease, I happen to know that this stalker is a scumbag, and many would like him dead, so killing him can be considered a good deed around here. And one more thing: be sure to bring me proof of his death: some personal thing, for example. Otherwise, no deal.
entries.JA_current: Don't worry, you can put your moral principles aside. And one more thing: be sure to bring me proof of his death: some personal thing, for example. Otherwise, no deal.
entries.JA_new: 心配するな。良心だの道徳だのは脇に置いておけ。罪悪感を軽くしてやるために言っておくが、そいつは最低な野郎だ。死んでほしいと思ってる奴も大勢いる。始末すれば、ここじゃ善行扱いだ。もう一つ、死んだ証拠を持ってこい。身につけていた物でいい。そうでなきゃ取引は成立しない。
